title: Event deck (v2)
description: A deck of event cards the engine draws from (#40; the word Director is retired, plan section 2). A card is data only: `conditions` it needs held to be eligible, a `weight` that is a live multiplier so real causes make it more likely, `limits` on how often and how much, how long it runs, what the sim does at its start and end (hooks from a fixed vocabulary), how the storybook tells it, and which watch-test moment it produces. Times are in-world: 1 sim day = 24 sim hours = 1440 sim minutes = 180 real seconds when watching. v1 kept a fixed `preconditions` allow-list and a bare `weight` number; v2 replaces both so a card can read the Ledger and the actors, not only the clock and the weather.

timeScale.description: Unit conversions for the numbers on the cards. Copied from balance/farm.json outsideRules.clock.periodSec; never tuned here.

size.description: How big a thing this is in the world (the owner's decision, 2026-09-09, plan decision 16: "small thing most days, big thing a few a month; the big ones should not happen when I am not watching; the weight is for what is big or small"). `small` is the everyday texture — a stray cat on the fence, a rainbow, lamb zoomies, fog, fireflies, stargazing, a windfall — and draws on most farm days, watched or not: while the farm is unwatched the engine keeps drawing small cards at farm-day resolution and tells them to the chronicle, so the storybook has something to say about a week away. `big` is a set piece — the cliff storm, the first snow, a lost lamb, the caravan, shearing day, the birthday — drawn a few times a farm month and **only while the farm is watched**, so the owner never misses one. Size decides pacing and the watched gate; `weight` still decides which card of that size is drawn. The size of every card, with a one-line reason, is the table in docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md.
size.$comment: Required on every card and every authored event. packages/sim/src/engine/deck.ts fails at load on a missing or unknown size, the same way it fails on an unknown trigger kind — a card whose size the engine cannot read is a bug in one lane or the other, not a card that quietly never fires.

conditionOn.description: What a predicate reads. A clock or weather field (`season`, `weather`, `timeOfDay`); one proposed weather-history field carried over from v1's `recentWeather`, now shaped as an ordinary predicate instead of a bespoke object (`simMinutesSinceRain`, flagged to sim on #40 same as v1 flagged `recentWeather`); a Ledger stock, read the way `packages/sim/src/ledger/ledger.ts` already reads it today (`ledger.wool` and `ledger.grass` are the flock's mean level 0 to 1 — `meanOf`; `ledger.coins` is the bank; `ledger.flock` is sheep plus lambs — `ledgerFlock`); or a named actor predicate the engine computes from the actors (`dlFarFromFlock`, `flockScattered`, `merchantPresent`, `lambPresent`, `farmerPresent`, and `lambFarFromMother` — PROPOSED to sim on #40, same as `simMinutesSinceRain` and the `simDate` trigger's day-of-season: today's sim springs every lamb to a fixed point behind its mother every tick with no detachment behaviour, so this predicate cannot yet be true and #40 needs to add one). Plain-word meanings for every one of these are in docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md.

conditionOp.description: `eq`/`ne` compare one value (a season, a weather kind, a phase, a boolean). `in`/`not-in` take an array `value`, the v1 preconditions' allow-list in predicate shape. `gte`/`lte`/`gt`/`lt` compare a number (a Ledger stock, or `simMinutesSinceRain`).

condition.description: One predicate over world state, true or false the moment the engine looks. `value`'s shape follows `on`: `season`, `weather` and `timeOfDay` are held to their enums below (as a bare value for eq/ne, or an array of them for in/not-in), same guarantee v1's fixed `preconditions` gave; every other `on` (a Ledger stock, `simMinutesSinceRain`, or a named actor predicate) stays open here.

oneOf.description: season: value is a season, or an array of them for in/not-in.
weather: value is a weather kind, or an array of them for in/not-in.
timeOfDay: value is a phase, or an array of them for in/not-in.
Every other `on` (a Ledger stock, `simMinutesSinceRain`, or a named actor predicate): value stays open.

preconditions.description: v2 name: `conditions` on the card. Every listed predicate must hold at the moment of the draw; an empty or absent list means no constraint.

weight.description: A live multiplier: `base` (10 is ordinary, same scale as v1's bare number) times every entry in `multipliers` whose `when` holds at the draw. A lost lamb is not "needs a lamb, weight 3"; it is "needs a lamb, and far likelier when the flock is scattered, DL is far from it, and it is near dusk" (plan section 2).

times.description: How much `when` scales the base weight. Under 1 makes the card less likely; over 1, more.

limits.description: How often and how much of this card the engine allows. v1 had a bare `cooldownSimHours` on the card; v2 groups it with the pacing knobs the plan names (concurrency, a minimum gap between draws).

concurrent.description: How many copies of this card may be running at once. 1 for almost everything; a card that never sets a flag or spawns something exclusive could allow more.

minGapSimMinutes.description: Minimum sim-minutes between one draw of this card starting and the next, start to start. Always at least the card's own durationSimMinutes, since a card cannot be redrawn while still running.

cooldownSimHours.description: In-world hours after the card ends before it may fire again. Same field and meaning as v1's card-level `cooldownSimHours`.

hook.description: One named effect the sim implements. `op` picks the effect; the other keys are its arguments.

oneOf.description: Fade the scene's visibility (fog). 1 is clear, 0 is a wall of fog.
Put something on the field at a landmark from farm/spots.json. NPCs walk their own plan and leave by themselves; small life and creatures stay until the card ends when `untilEnd` is true.
Nudge mood on the Ledger. Small whole numbers; the Ledger clamps.
Add (or take) whole coins from the bank.
Set a named boolean on the state that behaviours and the renderer read. A flag set at start is cleared at end (the test checks).

hooks.description: `start` runs when the card fires, `end` when its duration runs out (or the sim ends it early). Both are lists so a card can do several things; an empty list is allowed.

storybook.description: How 'while you were gone' tells the card. One past-tense line under 90 characters; placeholders in braces are filled by the client from the event log. v2 adds `notability`.

notability.description: How much this line deserves a spot in a storybook page (plan section 2): 0 ordinary background, 1 a first or the rarest high point. Deviation-from-normal and firsts drive selection, not this number alone, but it is the card author's own read on where a moment sits.

moment.description: The watch-test moment the card's start produces (tools/qa/README.md). Distinctness is kind:detail, so pick a detail no ordinary moment uses. `bird`/`rabbit` are reserved for the small-life system's own ambient arrivals (tools/qa/README.md), not for cards.

beat.description: For people: what the player sees within one second of the start, and what marks the end.
